question: 7. * If the interviewer just asked #6, begin here: We just talked about pointing to ask for something, ASK ALL -> Does ____________ point with one finger just to show you something interesting?

ask_yes_followup.text: Please give me an example something he/she might point at to show you. (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

evaluate_behaviors.instruction: Does your child sometimes want you to see something interesting such as....

how_draw_attention.text: How does your child draw your attention to it? Would he/she point with one finger?

check_intent.text: Is this to show their interest, not to get help?
